content.title: Did ABC cancel 'The Bachelorette'? Taylor Frankie Paul update today
content.text: Updated March 19, 2026, 4:52 p.m. ETEditor's Note: This story has been updated in light of recent news that ABC cancelled Taylor Frankie Paul's "The Bachelorette" season. It is unclear if the new "Bachelorette" season will ever air, or what will replace the show, which was set to air Sunday, March 22.We knew there'd be drama when new "Bachelorette" Taylor Frankie Paul's season was set to air this weekend, but new domestic violence allegations against Taylor have soured Bachelor Nation and now, ABC has cancelled "The Bachelorette."ABC pulled "The Bachelorette" ahead of its planned "Bachelorette" premiere Sunday, March 22 in light of recent controversy surrounding a newly released video involving Paul and her ex-boyfriend Dakota Mortensen, Disney noted in a statement. In the video, released by TMZ, Paul allegedly throws a chair at Mortensen during an incident that led to Paul's arrest in 2024.Paul has not been arrested nor have domestic violence charges against Paul and Dakota Mortensen been filed. However, Utah police are actively investigating claims the "Secret Lives of Mormon Wives" star and her child's father engaged in a violent dispute in February in front of their child, USA TODAY reported.Fans say Paul's appearance on "Good Morning America" Wednesday morning did all but address the latest allegations, claiming Taylor "skirted" GMA anchor Lara Spencer's questions due to "PR training." Paul, who has three children — two with ex-husband Tate Paul — called it a "heavy time," before explaining on GMA that the negative media headlines make her feel as if it's "the end of the world."Filming for "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives" season 5 came to a halt due to Taylor's domestic violence allegations, Paul confirmed on GMA. When production on "SLOMW" resumes remains unclear; Hulu has not commented on the situation. Cast members including Jessi Draper (Ngatikaura) and other members of "MomTok" say they are "distancing themselves" from Paul amid the police investigation, according to People.Fans have watched Paul and Mortensen's rocky relationship on "Secret Lives" for years since the show premiered in 2024. Taylor was arrested in 2023 — police body-cam video of Taylor's arrest opened the first episode — and faced a slew of misdemeanor charges, according to police. Paul entered a plea on abeyance of aggravated assault, and while criminal charges were dropped, an aggravated assault charge remains on her record for three years until she meets the conditions of her guilty plea, according to People and The Salt Lake Tribune.As fans planned to gear up for ABC's "The Bachelorette" Sunday, March 22, what is actually going on with Taylor Frankie Paul? Here's the latest.Is 'The Bachelorette' cancelled? Did ABC cancel 'The Bachelorette?'Yes. Taylor Frankie Paul's "Bachelorette" 2026 season will not air this weekend as planned. ABC cancelled "The Bachelorette" amid an ongoing domestic violence investigation between Taylor Frankie Paul and ex-boyfriend Taylor Mortensen.The latest Bachelorette news comes after new lead Paul has thrown ABC into disarray ahead of the Season 22 premiere, set to air Sunday, March 22. There had been no prior indication ABC had planned to pull the series, with ABC sharing a new promotional teaser of Season 22 on the official "The Bachelorette" Instagram page earlier Thursday, signifying it was all but moving forward.Will ABC pull 'The Bachelorette' premiere?Yes. ABC has pulled "The Bachelorette" 2026 as police investigate domestic violence allegations against Taylor Frankie Paul. Police verified to USA TODAY there is an "ongoing domestic assault investigation" involving Paul and her ex-boyfriend, Dakota Mortensen.ABC teased the new "Bachelorette" start on Sunday with a promo trailer today of the new 2026 "Bachelorette" season before news broke that Season 22 would be cancelled.What happened to 'The Bachelorette?' Taylor Frankie Paul news todayABC's new "Bachelorette" Taylor Frankie Paul and ex-boyfriend Dakota Mortensen have made domestic violence allegations against one another stemming from an incident in Utah after "The Bachelorette" filming wrapped. Draper City Police Department in Utah made contact with both in late February; however, when the alleged domestic assault occurred was reportedly in January.When does the new season of 'The Bachelorette' 2026 air? 'Bachelorette' Taylor air date, timeUpdate: Taylor Frankie Paul's "Bachelorette" season was set to air Sunday, March 22, 2026. Disney has now cancelled this season of "The Bachelorette."Taylor Frankie Paul's "Bachelorette" season airs Sunday, March 22, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET on ABC. You can also stream "The Bachelorette" 2026 on Hulu. Be sure to set your DVR: The show is longer than usual, airing from about 8:02 p.m. ET to 10:02 p.m. ET, per ABC.Where can I watch 'The Bachelorette' 2026?Update: Disney and ABC cancelled "The Bachelorette" 2026 amid recent allegations against new lead, Taylor Frankie Paul, following a newly released video stemming from her 2023 arrest and allegations she engaged in a domestic violence incident.To watch "The Bachelorette," head to TV channel ABC or stream Taylor Frankie Paul's season on Hulu.Lori Comstock is a New Jersey-based journalist with the Mid-Atlantic Connect Team.
